description:
The business's facts everything Sightkick does reads (Settings → Brand Profile).
action:
- profile(description?, niche?, targetAudiences?, serviceArea?): Description, niche, audiences, service area: what's given changes.
- name(name): Rename the brand (its spellings keep the old name).
- add_offering(name, type, url?, description?): A product or service. Returns its id.
- edit_offering(id, name?, type?, url?, description?): Change an offering (get_settings offerings).
- remove_offering(id): Delete an offering and its images. Can't be undone.
- offering_image(id, url?, data?): Add a picture to an offering, by public url (up to 8 MB) or base64 data (up to 700 KB): PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF, five per offering.
- remove_offering_image(id, imageId): Take a picture off an offering (its imageId from get_settings offerings) and delete it. Can't be undone.
- market(country, language): The country and language (get_settings markets). After research it rebuilds it: fresh keyword research, the unwritten plan replanned, the prompts retired for a fresh set. 3 per week.
- timezone(timezone): An IANA name (Europe/Berlin): the day pages go out and the send window run on it.
name: update_brand
title: Change the brand profile
